narrativeProgression.description: Charlie introduces the location and plan for the hike.
Describes the Mount Tenerife Trail, but mentions he won't be going all the way to the peak.
Explains he'll hike to the top of the ridgeline for views of Middle Fork Snoqualmie Valley and Mount Rainier.
Describes the trail as recently converted from a road.

videoEditingDetails.description: Text overlay: "Mount Tenerife Trail - I90 Corridor 3-1-15"

keyMoments.changeDescription: Shift in music tempo and mood

narrativeProgression.description: Hike begins at a closed gate.
A small waterfall appears along the trail.
First glimpse of Mount Rainier through the trees.
View of Mount Tenerife, the hike's namesake.
Charlie sits for a moment of "zazen" meditation.
View of Rattlesnake Ledge and Rattlesnake Lake.

climax.description: Scene 3 (around 1:52) when Mount Rainier first becomes visible, followed by views of Mount Tenerife and Rattlesnake Ledge.
